items.summary:
X 刚上线了个新功能，普通人连视频都不用拍，就有机会靠剪辑赚钱了

原作者和剪辑的人都可以拿到收益。这是 @XCreators 新推出的 Clipping功能，配合Grok Bot，我觉得真可以研究一下。

4步上手，直接开干：

① 找热门长视频

盯住海外播客、AI访谈、科技大佬的精彩对话，优先找争议大、有看点的内容。原视频至少2分钟，如果不知道怎么找，就用grok帮你搜寻热门的帖子

② 用Grok Bot 自动挑选高光片段

直接把视频交给能访问素材的 Grok，复制这段提示词：

「分析这段视频，找出5个最有传播潜力的片段，标注准确时间戳、核心观点和推荐理由。再选出最精彩的一段，写一条有冲突点、能引发讨论的X配文，不要编造剧情。」

③ 我自己也试了一把 

拿 @dwarkesh_sp  的AI 对局视频测试，Grok 直接挑出 Slayer 开枪后 Claude 和 GPT 判断不同的精彩片段，连配文和讨论话题都写好了。

下面这段就是我实测的结果，效果还不错。

④ 直接剪辑，研究变现

手机端打开符合条件的 X 视频 → 转推图标 → Clip video，剪出5～60秒的片段，且不能超过原视频的30%，再配上自己的观点发布，注意原视频必须超过两分钟

符合资格后参与 X 原创内容奖励分成，或者帮海外博主做付费剪辑。

一场2小时的播客，可能就藏着十几个值得传播的片段。

我的逻辑就是用Grok帮我找，X 帮我剪，剩下的看流量。 https://t.co/4SInv5vZST

items.summary: Some will argue that AI should be a neutral aggregator of information. But AI cannot be neutral: Every accurate answer excludes many additional facts and emphasizes some over others. Chris Klomp, the nominee for deputy secretary of Health and Human Services, has called AI in patient care the agency’s “holy grail” for improving the nation’s health. [...] Medical ethics pairs the duty to do no harm with beneficence, which is an affirmative obligation to do good. Safety evaluations of AI have focused mainly on the first duty by screening for responses that encourage imminent self-harm, discourage necessary care, or spread false information. Behavioral benchmarking would extend the first duty beyond imminent danger to long-term harms. It could also advance the second duty, which has received far less attention: designing AI to help people by

items.title: Why is Nvidia so powerful in the AI world, and what could Jensen Huang’s scandal really cost?
items.summary:
The AI sector is notorious for the amount of circular financing going on – where companies invest in their own suppliers or customers. Nvidia is a key player in this loop.

Investors are already fretting over whether the enormous amounts of money sunk into AI can ever return profits.

While leading AI model builders Anthropic and OpenAI are moving toward public listings or fresh funding rounds, both face harsh reality checks. [...] The now multi-trillion-dollar company got its start making chips called graphic processing units (GPUs), used largely for video games. However, these chips – and their successors – turned out to be ideal for the kind of number-crunching needed for training and using AI models.

Other companies such as Google and AMD have tried to make chips that can compete with Nvidia for speed and efficiency, however neither has been able to displace Nvidia from its dominance of the AI market. [...] Computer chips – specifically the chips used to produce and run artificial intelligence (AI) systems – have become a key front in the United States’ rivalry with China for geopolitical power and influence. The most powerful chips are needed for the most advanced AI, and the US has tried to maintain its edge over China by restricting access to those chips.

While the Chinese government rejects claims of espionage, Alice Huang has reportedly been under investigation by the US for years.

items.title: Có Nên Học Công Nghệ Thông Tin? Học CNTT Có Khó Không?
items.summary:
## Ai Phù Hợp Với Ngành Công Nghệ Thông Tin?

Ngành Công nghệ thông tin phù hợp với người yêu thích công nghệ, có tư duy logic, kiên trì giải quyết vấn đề và sẵn sàng tự học. Không nhất thiết phải biết lập trình trước khi vào đại học, nhưng học sinh nên có hứng thú tìm hiểu cách các hệ thống máy tính và ứng dụng hoạt động.

### Những Tố Chất Phù Hợp Với Ngành CNTT

Dưới đy là một số đặc điểm có thể giúp học sinh học tập và phát triển trong ngành. [...] Có nên học Công nghệ thông tin? Học CNTT có khó không? Đy là những băn khoăn phổ biến của học sinh THPT khi đứng trước lựa chọn ngành học. Công nghệ thông tin (CNTT) vẫn có nhiều hướng nghề nghiệp trong lĩnh vực phần mềm, dữ liệu, bảo mật và hệ thống máy tính. Tuy nhiên, ngành học này đòi hỏi khả năng tư duy logic, kiên trì thực hành và chủ động cập nhật kiến thức. Để quyết định có nên học CNTT, học sinh cần nhìn nhận thực tế thị trường việc làm, độ khó của chương trình và mức độ phù hợp với [...] Nên học Công nghệ thông tin nếu bạn yêu thích công nghệ, có khả năng tư duy logic và sẵn sàng dành thời gian học tập, thực hành lu dài. Ngành CNTT phù hợp với người muốn sử dụng máy tính và phần mềm để giải quyết vấn đề thực tế, không chỉ với những học sinh đã biết lập trình từ THPT.

Tuy nhiên, quyết định chọn ngành cần dựa trên sở thích, năng lực và mục tiêu nghề nghiệp thay vì kỳ vọng rằng học CNTT chắc chắn có thu nhập cao.

### Những Lý Do Nên Cn Nhắc Ngành Công Nghệ Thông Tin

items.summary:
We built Control Room, a central system to track model workloads across our research infrastructure and stop them quickly when safety or security concerns arise.

It connects every research inference workload, including agentic sampling for model training and evaluation, data processing, and more. This works together with our misalignment monitoring systems, and halts model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene to stop or pause a job.

Control Room is just one part of our holistic approach for safe frontier model training and deployment.

items.title: A new way to measure how AI agents handle the routine analyses of wet-lab science—BioBasicsBench.
items.summary:
A new way to measure how AI agents handle the routine analyses of wet-lab science—BioBasicsBench.

Developed with Ligo, a biotech company focused on enzyme design, the benchmark draws on 100 tasks from real experiments to test whether agents can interpret raw lab data, identify errors, and recognize when the evidence doesn’t support a conclusion.

Accelerating biological research starts with getting the everyday work right. BioBasicsBench shows where models need to improve, and helps us track what those gains mean for scientific progress, biosafety, and biosecurity.

https://t.co/wN2xLk0YeW

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Geek+ Unveils 24/7 Warehouse Autonomy Plan to Advance Self-Optimizing, Around-the-Clock Operation | Morningstar
items.summary: Geek+ offers a comprehensive portfolio of end-to-end warehouse robotics solutions, spanning tote-, pallet- and shelf-based workflows and applications such as material transport, storage, retrieval and order picking. Its AMR systems support high-throughput execution of structured tasks, while embodied AI is being developed to extend automation into more variable handling activities and exception recovery. Together, these capabilities form an important foundation for continuous autonomous [...] Physical AI is extending robotics beyond highly structured material-handling tasks into more complex manipulation and exception handling. Meanwhile, advances in AI are bringing greater intelligence to robot fleet coordination, warehouse workflows and day-to-day operations. Together, these developments are laying the groundwork for a new operating model: autonomous warehousing. [...] "Over the past 11 years, Geek+ has demonstrated that warehouse robotics can deliver value at scale in real operations around the world," said Yong Zheng, Founder and CEO of Geek+. "Our next goal is to enable the warehouse as a whole to operate more autonomously and continuously improve. By advancing embodied AI and warehouse-wide intelligence-and building on our global deployment capabilities-we aim to make autonomous warehouses a practical foundation for the next generation of logistics."

items.title: DataLogix AI Launches Workplace Video Resources for Businesses Exploring AI and Robotics Training
items.summary:

These examples are discussion starting points, not confirmed eligible categories. The guidance asks owners to review participant consent, recording permissions, safety, equipment and footage acceptance criteria before beginning. [...] DataLogix AI, a division of Trailblaze Solutions LLC, has launched online resources to help business owners explore first-person workplace video for AI and robotics training. The new resources include a workplace-video overview, an adjustable revenue calculator, a business owner guide and an inquiry form for discussing potential fit. [...] Businesses interested in learning more can use the inquiry form to describe their company and the opportunity they would like to discuss. An inquiry is not enrollment, recording permission or a payment offer. Program availability, equipment and commercial terms require separate confirmation, and payment may be zero.

The AI lab on Thursday laid out policies — in the works since August — intended to help the company build more trust with local communities and convince them that data centers will ​benefit them. items.title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say | Reuters
items.summary:
OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

Some OpenAI employees are increasingly worried about this approach as AI grows more capable, according to the five people. [...] When asked about employees' concerns and their view that management did not act on these issues, OpenAI spokesperson Elana Widmann ​said that OpenAI is one of the most targeted organizations in the world. As a result, the company invests heavily in its security program to protect against attacks from insiders, cybercriminals and nation-states, she said. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

These workers argued that OpenAI's controls were so lax ‌that outsiders, including foreign governments, could obtain sensitive information about the AI lab's technology with relative ease, the people said. For example, anybody at OpenAI who could access its code could see the technical details underlying many company projects.
